hooks.name: Remind the agent to surface new findings to the human
hooks.description: When a migration's findings.yaml is first created, asks the agent to summarise the findings for the human and not to decide any of them.

action.prompt: A new findings.yaml was just created for a migration. Read it and give the human a short list of the findings (id, cell, what the workbook contradicts). Do not decide any finding, do not edit decisions.yaml, do not record a decision, and do not run any macro or modify any workbook. Ask the human which behaviour is correct for each finding that needs a Decision.
